status: candidate frozen references; derived and cross-checked by their author, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic Timoshenko (or Euler-Bernoulli) straight members; K_s = G kappa_E A_n on the nominal annulus; rotations are section rotations

conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.support_reaction_magnitude: Euclidean norm of the support's force or moment components
conventions.section_action: element-local action on the +x face of the i-side portion at station s/L (local x from i to j); a node-on-element end action is -section(0) at end_i and +section(1) at end_j
conventions.section_stress: bending normal stress M / Z of the station's section action on the named basis, Z = I / R
conventions.elastic_maximum: max over the pipe of |N|/A_b + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b on the named basis; governing_fraction is its location s/L
conventions.local_axes: x along the chord from i to j; y = y_reference projected normal to x; z = x cross y
conventions.exact: a sum of rational * [sqrt(rational)] * [pi or 1/pi]; irrational values carry a rigorous interval

criterion: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest magnitude of that family in the case)
